info.title: Flowmate Platform API
info.description:
Single API reference for the Flowmate platform.

It includes the core Flowmate workflow service, the customer-specific Flowmate CA services, and the shared Flowmate Common master-data service.

servers.description: Current application host; paths include each CAP service base path

tags.name: Flowmate CA — Service Entry Sheet Details
Flowmate CA — Service Entry Sheet Items
Flowmate CA Master — Workflow Step Configs

post.description:
Group multiple requests into a single request payload, see [Batch Requests](http://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_BatchRequests).

*Please note that "Try it out" is not supported for this request.*

multipart/mixed;boundary=request-separat.example:
--request-separator
Content-Type: application/http
Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary

GET ProcessTypes HTTP/1.1
Accept: application/json


--request-separator--

multipart/mixed.example:
--response-separator
Content-Type: application/http

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{...}
--response-separator--
